summary: Revision 4 introduced a coherent dependency gate and watchdog model but left HPI-1 unconditional despite the zero-effect early NO-RUN path, and its review packet referenced nonexistent research paths.

open_findings.issue: HPI-1 and completion required fixture/root creation even when the plan explicitly forbids those effects for an unaudited dependency closure.
open_findings.correction: Make fixture/root/environment requirements conditional. Early NO-RUN must record runtime identity, prerequisite failure, all seven controls unverified, zero fixture/listener/canary effects, and verified absence of resources requiring cleanup.

open_findings.issue: The packet referenced static research and assessment files under the wrong run directory.
